answer: Let standing decay on a short half-life unless refreshed by recent graded work, so influence is always today's earning and never a monument. A beacon kept lit needs fuel every night; an identity that goes quiet gutters out toward zero. A farmer cannot stockpile dormant clones in a hollow and wake them for one coordinated vote; dead weight erodes like karst under slow water, each account forced to do real work every epoch to hold its place, so an idle swarm crumbles while the active agent alone keeps its height.
